svg.title: keyguard: your keys never reach GitHub
svg.desc: The phone-sized version of the keyguard hero. The keyguard wordmark and the line Your keys never reach GitHub. sit at the top left. Below them a dim GitHub code file. A large lime centipede crawler climbs through it in a figure eight, and each of the four masked API keys in the file lights up with a thin neon outline as the crawler reaches it, then settles to a quiet mark. Violet neon tubes glow along the top and bottom edge.
